name: Tag
description: The Tag component provides a visually distinct label that can be used to categorize content, display status, or highlight key information.
usage: Multiple color variants for different contexts
Two sizes: md (default) and sm for compact layouts
Optional icon support with proper vertical alignment
Consistent styling with the design system
Use for status indicators with icons (e.g., Pending, Approved)
Use for metadata display (e.g., 2 min read)
Designed for inline display with text content
Use success/error/info/caution variants for status feedback
Icons automatically sized based on tag size (h-3 w-3 for sm, h-4 w-4 for md)
design: Rounded-full shape creates a pill design
md size: type-label with px-3 py-2 padding and gap-2 for icon/text spacing
sm size: type-label-compact with px-3 py-1.5 padding and gap-1.5 for icon/text spacing
Icon and text in separate flex containers for proper vertical alignment
Text wrapper uses leading-none and mt-0.5 to compensate for font baseline offset
Icons sized automatically: h-3 w-3 for sm, h-4 w-4 for md
Uses flexbox gap for consistent spacing between icon and text
Uses design token color variables for proper theming
default variant: Primary background with --color-text-on-primary for WCAG compliance
accent variant: Accent background with --color-text-on-accent for WCAG compliance
muted variant: Subtle section background with default text color
success variant: Success background (--color-success-bg) with success foreground text
error variant: Error background (--color-error-bg) with error foreground text
info variant: Info background (--color-info-bg) with info foreground text
caution variant: Caution background (--color-caution-bg) with caution foreground text
